testScenario: Lab 2 - Scenario 5: Service Failure and Incident Recovery
description: Simulates payment gateway endpoint throwing HTTP 500 error due to transient upstream network degradation. Operate flags incident, operator updates retry policy or re-triggers after mock service recovers.

operateIncidentInspection.errorMessage: REST Connector execution failed: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error contacting payment gateway
resolutionAndRecovery: 1. Navigate to Camunda 8 Operate -> Instances with Incidents.
4. Mock payment gateway is restarted or paymentToken corrected to tok_visa_valid_9988 in variable editor.
5. Click 'Retry' on the incident in Operate.
6. Payment succeeds and token moves to Activity_FulfillAndDispatch.
